name: Adlerhorst-Panoramasteg am Achensee
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The newly built Adlerhorst Panorama Bridge seamlessly blends into the vertical cliff face of the Achensee at 80 meters high. On this fully secured, circular walkway, you literally stroll above the deep turquoise waters of Tirol’s deepest lake. A breathtaking view of the Karwendel and Rofangebirg mountain ranges is assured.
